test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is the author of the book 'The Three Khans: And the Emergence of New India'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kaveree Bamzai.**__

__
 
• “The Three Khans: And the Emergence of New India” is written by Kaveree Bamzai.
 
• Kaveree Bamzai is an Indian journalist, author, and film critic.
